subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: Should GitHub-backed publisher display manifests retain a complete-catalog contract, or should this issue require a bounded/paginated manifest representation before it can be considered complete?
rationale: The merged partial implementation intentionally left this path unresolved because its consumer-visible completeness requirements determine whether a mechanical read bound is safe.

options.title: Bound the manifest path
options.body: Define a bounded manifest representation and implement it with focused compatibility coverage for GitHub-backed publisher display behavior.

options.title: Document an intentional complete manifest
options.body: Keep the full-catalog read only if maintainers explicitly accept the cost and record why the consumer cannot use a bounded representation.

options.title: Split the remaining work
options.body: Create a narrow follow-up for the manifest contract and keep this issue open as the umbrella until that work is resolved.

recommendation.title: Bound the manifest path
recommendation.body: Define a bounded manifest representation and implement it with focused compatibility coverage for GitHub-backed publisher display behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the source audit and the merged partial implementation, including the stated completion boundary.
